intro: Duluth has a long community sauna tradition, and today's public options include a 1920s-era steam bath downtown, a harborside Nordic sauna with a floating sauna and Lake Superior cold plunge at Pier B, and a mobile wood-fired sauna that sets up community sessions around town. Hours and locations change by season, so confirm with each venue before you go.

venues.name: Cedar & Stone Nordic Sauna (Pier B flagship)
venues.drop_in_price: $49 per guest for Open Sauna (walk-ups welcome, no reservation) or a Social Sauna session; $30 local rate via email promo code; private sessions from $79 per guest
venues.session_length: At least 90 minutes for Open Sauna; 75 minutes for Social Sauna and social floating sauna
venues.cold_plunge: Harborside natural cold plunge in Lake Superior (included, optional)
venues.schedule: Thursday-Monday 9am-9pm. Open Sauna sessions start every 45 minutes from 2:45pm to 8:45pm. Social sessions are shared with up to 10 guests; all other session types are reserved in advance.
venues.notes: Three saunas on site: a wood-fired social sauna, an electric private sauna and a wood-fired floating sauna. Guided sessions with tea, towels and outdoor cold showers. Bring a swimsuit and footwear for the plunge in freezing weather. Also offers a $25 monthly community cold plunge (second Sunday). The venue's page lists $49 for Open Sauna; third-party booking sites show different totals with fees.

venues.name: Duluth Family Sauna
venues.drop_in_price: Bull Pen (men only) $24.25 one-time entry or $27.25 day pass; private room $20.25 for one person, $28.25 for two, $43.25 for three; $13.75 seniors (65+) and veterans
venues.session_length: Private rooms up to 2 hours; Bull Pen stay as long as you like until close
venues.schedule: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat and Sun noon-10pm; closed Tue and Thu. Cash only. Photo ID required for private rooms. Free visit during your birthday month.
venues.notes: Operating at this location since the 1920s and described by the venue as a steam bath near Lake Superior. The Bull Pen is men only; private rooms are open to men and women. Bring your own towel for a reduced rate. No massage services. Heat type is not stated beyond 'steam bath'.

venues.name: Sauna du Nord
venues.drop_in_price: $35 per seat at a public session (posted on the venue's site); $245 private session for up to 10
venues.schedule: Community sessions run at rotating locations; the site's last posted residency was Caribou Lake in January 2026 (Wed, Thu, Sat). Current dates and locations Unknown; check the venue's Facebook page.
venues.notes: Locally owned mobile sauna on wheels with a wood stove and changing room; seats roughly 6-10. Seats are bookable when sessions are posted, and private events are by request. Confirm current availability before planning a trip.
